messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "impaired decision making"
set: ["impaired decision making", "commercial decision", "impaired thinking", "impaired concentration", "making lifestyle changes", "impaired reaction time", "impaired kidney function", "impaired thinking or reactions", "Impaired vitamin B-12 absorption", "decision to stop or continue sertraline", "your reactions could be impaired", "make decision with doctor rather than stopping on own", "impaired ability to drive or perform hazardous tasks", "body stops making enough of its own steroid hormones", "replacing thyroid hormone that your body is not making enough of", "wegovy flextouch pen not recommended for self-injection if visually impaired"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
